title: P.G. Lust, Soviet Official

page_data.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT
（印：C.I.B. 4412 / NIEDRICH - SMITH / Date May 1st 1933 10 am）
Subject (in full) P.G.Lust , Soviet Official.
Made by D.S.Prokofiev Forwarded by （签名）
With reference to the attached translation from French
Police Daily Intelligence report dated Jamary 10,1933,enquiries
have failed to verify the information regarding the presence in
Shanghai of one P.G.Lust who is believed to be an agent of the
People's Commissariat of Foreign Affairs.
So far, no information has been received regarding
the arrival in Shanghai of members of the Soviet diplomatic
or consular staff who are married to Chinese.
（批：拟）
G. Prokofiev
D. S.
Officer i/c Special Branch.
（签名）
（签名）
MAY 22 1933

事由（全称） P.G.Lust，苏联官员。
制作人 D.S.Prokofiev 转发人 （签名）

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL
S. REGIST
D 4412
18/1 p3

Translation of extract from French Police Daily Intelligence
Report dated January 10, 1933

Parag. I. Information regarding P.G. Lust

We learn that a certain P.G.Lust arrived in Shanghai
from the U.S.S.R. recently. He is believed to be an agent of
the People's Commissariat of Foreign Affairs. He arrived in
company with his wife, a Chinese, who is believed to have attended
propaganda training course at Moskow. P.G.Lust speaks Chinese
fluently. On January 8, together with his wife, he proceeded to
Nanking by rail. While in Shanghai he resided with I.Babitch,
sub-manager of the local branch of the Centrosojus, in Apartment
No 308, Majestic Apartments.

We are informed from another source that several other
Soviet agents employed by the People's Commissariat of Foreign
Affairs or by INO ( Foreign Service of the G.P.U.) and who are
married to Chinese, will arrive in China shortly. It is believed
that they will be sent in the interior of the country where
they will be attached to the future Consulates of the U.S.S.R.

SI,
Please see and pass
back to S2 (watch and
report in case of
developments.

18/1/33

1933年1月10日法国警察每日情报报告摘录译文

第一段. 关于 P.G. Lust 的情报

我们获悉，某位 P.G.Lust 最近从苏维埃社会主义共和国联盟抵达上海。据信他是外交人民委员部的特工。他与妻子（一名中国人）同行，其妻据信曾在莫斯科参加宣传培训课程。P.G.Lust 能流利地说中文。1月8日，他与妻子乘火车前往南京。在上海期间，他借住在 Centrosojus（中央消费合作总社）本地分行副经理 I.Babitch 处，住址为迈尔西爱公寓（Majestic Apartments）308室。

我们从另一消息源获悉，另有几名受雇于外交人民委员部或国家政治保卫总局对外情报局（INO）且与中国人结婚的苏联特工，即将抵达中国。据信，他们将被派往内地，并隶属于苏联未来的领事馆。

SI，
请阅后转回 S2（监视并在有进展时报告）。

JR
1933年1月18日
